Nippon India Growth Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth is a Equity Mutual Fund Scheme launched by Nippon India Mutual Fund. This scheme was made available to investors on 30 Jun 1995. Rupesh Patel is the Current Fund Manager of Nippon India Growth Mid Cap Fund Direct Growth fund. The fund currently has an Asset Under Management(AUM) of ₹7,62,869 Cr and the Latest NAV as of 30 Oct 2026 is ₹4,611.22.
